vocabulary.example: The subway station is very convenient.

grammar.explanation_en: Combine prepositions (near, next to, across from, within walking distance of) with adjectives (quiet, convenient, crowded) to describe a neighborhood in detail: 'My apartment is near the subway, but the area can be crowded.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 전치사(near, next to, across from, within walking distance of)와 형용사(quiet, convenient, crowded)를 결합해 동네를 자세히 묘사할 수 있습니다: 'My apartment is near the subway, but the area can be crowded.'(제 아파트는 지하철 근처인데, 그 지역이 붐빌 때가 있어요)

examples.en: My house is within walking distance of the school.
examples.ko: 저희 집은 학교까지 걸어갈 수 있는 거리예요.

examples.en: This neighborhood is quiet and convenient.
The market is across from my apartment.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: It's quiet and convenient. There's a market nearby.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Not too bad. My landlord is also very nice.

reading.title: Finding a New Home
reading.text: Last month, we moved into a new apartment. The neighborhood is quiet, and there's a supermarket within walking distance. The rent is a bit high, but the location is very convenient. Our landlord is friendly and always helps us quickly. We are happy here.
reading.text_ko: 지난달 저희는 새 아파트로 이사했어요. 동네는 조용하고, 걸어갈 수 있는 거리에 슈퍼마켓이 있어요. 월세는 좀 비싸지만 위치가 아주 편리해요. 집주인은 친절하고 항상 빠르게 도와주세요. 저희는 이곳에서 만족하고 있어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'The neighborhood is quiet.'
The text says 'Our landlord is friendly and always helps us quickly.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'friendly and always helps us quickly'라고 나옵니다.
